proposal.task: Fix SiPacker header layout to match SiCartridgeHeader specification
observations: si_packer.rs writes version as u32 at offset 4, but SiCartridgeHeader expects u16 at offset 4, causing version spill into header_size field.
si_packer.rs writes toc_len as u64 at offset 12, but SiCartridgeHeader expects crc32_checksum (u32) at offset 12 and block1_offset (u64) starting at offset 16, causing data corruption.
SiPacker uses serde_json for serialization which is slower and less compact than bincode, violating hot-path performance constraints.
risks: Existing SiForge cartridges may fail to load if they rely on the legacy layout interpretation.
CRC32 calculation must be deterministic and match SiCartridgeEngine expectations.
Changing header layout may break SiSolidStateLoader if it expects the legacy format.
test_plan: Verify SiPacker writes correct header layout with u16 version and u32 flags.
Verify SiSolidStateLoader can load the new format without errors.
Verify tensor offsets are correctly aligned and accessible.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Refactor SiPacker to write SiCartridgeHeader layout with correct field sizes and add CRC32 checksum calculation.
